capabilities: Capture text, attachments and voice notes through a global-hotkey popup window
Run a separate daemon app so capture works while Obsidian is closed
Sort captures into user-defined categories shown as pills
Browse captures in a bento-grid inbox with text, image, PDF and audio previews
Search captures by words, tags, category, file type and name with suggestions
disambiguation: Not a notification tool; despite the name it is a quick-capture window and inbox for notes.
extras: Quick capture needs a separate daemon downloaded manually from release pages (with .sha256 checksums); Linux is the best-tested platform, Windows and macOS builds have had less testing; no network requests, telemetry, accounts or payment.
problem: Obsidian's own capture needs the app open, so fleeting thoughts, files and voice notes are easy to lose when it is closed.
summary: Quick-capture plugin that saves thoughts, files and voice notes as Markdown notes into an inbox, even when Obsidian is closed.
